hero.h1: Kibay Sparkling – Sustainable Sparkling Wine with Mango & Passion Fruit
hero.intro: The full experience. Our 750ml bottle is designed for the table, bringing the elegance of Dominican winemaking to your gatherings.

crafted.heading: Crafted in the Dominican Republic
crafted.body: An expression of terroir unlike any other. We cultivate our grapes and tropical fruits in the unique microclimate of Ocoa Bay, resulting in a sparkling wine that is both sophisticated and wildly natural.

process.heading: Fermentation & Wine Process
process.body: Patience defines our process. The secondary fermentation occurs naturally, integrating the delicate aromas of mango and passion fruit into the structure of the wine itself, not just as a flavoring.

sustainable.heading: Sustainable Ingredients & Natural Profile
sustainable.body: We believe that great wine starts in the vineyard. Our sustainable farming practices ensure that every bottle is free from harmful chemicals, preserving the health of our soil and the purity of your glass.

tasting.heading: Tasting Notes
tasting.nose: Elegant floral notes layered with ripe tropical fruit and a hint of fresh yeast.
tasting.palate: Balanced and round. The passion fruit provides a zesty backbone to the lush mango body.
tasting.finish: Sophisticated and dry, inviting another sip.

enjoy.heading: How to Enjoy Kibay
enjoy.body1: Best served chilled between 6-8°C in a flute or white wine glass.
enjoy.body2: A stunning centerpiece for celebrations. Excellent with spicy Caribbean dishes, Asian fusion cuisine, or simply as a toast to life's special moments.
